source_material_contract_notes.text: 2098-bit exact domain includes values above DBL_MAX. Positive carriers remain exact; rounded diagnostics/Count2 export may explicitly refuse overflow. This agrees with implementation and existing range contract; callers must not require a scalar to conserve count.

At hi=DBL_MAX, nextafter(hi,+inf)-hi is infinity, so the shared normalization predicate accepts large negative low limbs, including complete cancellation. Exact value is still conserved and export renormalizes it; this is inherited Count2 admission behavior, not silent count corruption or a new physical source admission. Tightening it needs a shared Count2 contract decision.

Gas count uses exact positive leaves; source/adsorbed Count2 remains its own owner. Full-time source preflight must prove exact source inventory delta equals actual emitted native weights. Do not use successful gas debit/export as proof that a separate heat Count2 debit was exact. The production spatial material port can form exact atoms/mass/E from all positive native leaves without Count2 export.

limits: parent-subflow integration suite owned by root
physical packet weight validity, source-rate selection or C19 physics
all allocation-failure paths and all floating environment modes
